Explosion History

Chapter 01

How It All Started

We are Elena & Dennis, a passionate duo who launched Explosion in 2022.
What began as a shared dream has grown into a vibrant community.
Join us as we take you through our journey and history.

Chapter 02

Why Explosion Was Created

Explosion was created because of our shared dream: to build a community in Berlin that's hungry to improve and to become the best community in Europe.
We wanted to bring joy to events and change the way they are done, where dancers focus on passion, not just product.

Chapter 03

What Drives Us

It is our community: the friends we have made throughout the journey, the people who smile at us, and everyone who helps make our events possible. Thank you, btw <3

Chapter 04

Leveling Up

We are always pushing to change what is possible in Berlin. Since 2022, we have worked to bring the best talent to the city, host the highest-quality workshops, and create unforgettable experiences for dancers.

Chapter 05

Our Spirit

We believe dancing should be for everyone: to enjoy themselves, challenge themselves, and grow together. What we strive to create is an atmosphere like meeting your friends, only there are a lot more of them.

Chapter 06

Community Grows

Our community keeps growing. Each year our family becomes bigger and stronger. We are incredibly grateful to see our concept embraced so warmly and received so positively.

Chapter 07

New Concepts

We were the first event in Germany and the second in Europe to dedicate an entire edition to Role Rotation, a concept created to bring freedom to the dancefloor and promote greater equality in social dancing. We repeat it every year.

Chapter 08

The Future

We will keep growing and striving to make Berlin the capital of Bachata, with bigger events, bigger venues, and a bigger Explosion every single year.

Chapter 09

Are You Ready to Join Us?

We hope we have inspired you to join our events and given you a clearer insight into our goals, our journey, and who we are. Let’s dance together and keep the Explosion growing!

Chapter 10

We Are Explosion

Thank you for reading a bit more about us. If you want to see all our previous events, keep scrolling and enjoy the journey.

Masters League

The Bachata Battle Masters League is a solo dance competition designed to spotlight personal style, creativity, and musical connection in the world of bachata. Unlike partner-based formats, here you shine on your own — it’s about how you interpret the music, move with confidence, and stand out from the crowd.

The event begins with a freestyle preselection known as the cypher. All registered dancers enter the floor in a large circle and freestyle to curated bachata music. Judges carefully observe and select the Top 16 dancers based on their understanding of bachata fundamentals, body movement quality, connection to musical accents, and stage presence.

Once the Top 16 are chosen, the real battle begins. Dancers face off one-on-one in a bracket system. Each round uses different music to challenge their versatility:

  • Round of 16: modern bachata hits
  • Quarterfinals: traditional bachata
  • Semifinals: sensual/modern tracks with musical accents
  • Final: each dancer performs two rounds to contrasting songs, designed to push expression and musical storytelling to the limit

Judging Criteria:

  • Bachata Foundations — clear footwork, authentic body movement, grounded energy
  • Musicality — how well dancers react to rhythm changes, pauses, and instrumentation
  • Presence & Style — confidence, originality, creativity in using space, and connection with the audience

Judges may provide live feedback and may call for a tiebreaker if needed.

Prizes:

  • 🥇 1st place: 100€ in cash, 2 full festival passes, and the opportunity to teach at the Explosion Festival 2026 — one of Europe’s biggest bachata events!
  • 🥈 2nd place: 3 full passes
  • 🥉 3rd place: 2 full passes

Most importantly, this league is built on community and respect. All dancers are welcome — regardless of style, experience, or identity. We stand for good vibes, support, and honest expression. Bad sportsmanship or discrimination won’t be tolerated. Bring your energy, your passion, and your truth. This is your stage.

You’re here for a reason. Show up, shine, and let your dancing speak.

FAQ

Everything you might want to know about Berlin Bachata Festival: tickets, venue, schedule, competitions and more.

Where is the festival happening? +

The festival takes place at MOA Bogen / Mercure Hotel MOA Berlin, Stephanstraße 41, 10559 Berlin. Workshops, parties and socials are all in one location.

How do I buy tickets and what is included? +

Tickets are sold via Ticket Tailor. The Full Pass includes workshops and parties unless stated otherwise on the ticket page. Some add-ons or special intensives may be sold separately.

Can I get a refund or resell my ticket? +

Ticket policies can vary by edition. If refunds are not possible, name changes or transfers may be possible. An admin fee of 10€ may apply. Please check Ticket Tailor or contact us.

Do I need a partner to join workshops? +

No. You can join without a partner. We usually rotate during workshops and do our best to create a balanced experience.

What levels are the workshops? +

We typically offer multiple levels such as improver, intermediate and advanced. Level descriptions are published with the schedule so you can choose what fits you best.

What is the dress code for the parties? +

There is no strict dress code. Come comfortable, confident and ready to dance.

When will the schedule be published? +

The schedule is published on the website and social media once finalized. Small timing updates can happen close to the event.

Are drinks available at the venue? +

Yes. A 10€ drinks fee can be added with your Full Pass, allowing you to drink throughout the day and night during the festival.

Is there a cloakroom or changing area? +

We aim to provide a cloakroom setup and basic changing options. Details such as hours and pricing are shared closer to the festival.

When does the competition happen? +

The first round of the competition is planned for Friday, with finals on Saturday.

Can I volunteer or become an ambassador? +

Yes. Volunteer and ambassador programs open based on capacity. Check the Get Involved sections or contact us to apply.

How can I contact you? +

The fastest way is email or the contact form. You can also reach us through Instagram DM.

Still have questions?

If you did not find what you need, reach out. We usually respond quickly.

Finalize Your Registration

Your competition spot is only guaranteed once your checkout has been completed successfully. If you enter a valid Full Pass code, your spot is secured after confirmation.

How to Complete Registration

Step 1

Select the access code

Choose your J&J ticket and the required pass.

Enter the code as shown

Important Rules

Competition Guidelines

  • This is a social dance competition.
  • No acrobatics allowed, neither solo nor with a partner.
  • Judging focuses on basic step, hip movement, posture, and overall dancing ability.
  • Focus on connection, musicality, and real social dance quality.
  • One week before the event, we will publish a Spotify playlist with 100 possible songs.

Ticket Confirmation

  • Your spot is confirmed only after checkout is completed.
  • Full Pass holders secure their spot via code.
  • Please keep your confirmation email.

Judging Criteria 📝

  1. Connection & Technique
  2. Musicality & Styling
  3. Creativity & Entertainment

you will receive your decision right after the round.

Rounds

  • First Round – Cypher: initial eliminations.
  • Final Round: the top dancers compete for the win.

The Finals 🏆

In the final, we will have a surprise round, where we will place a challenge for one of the parts (leader or follower).

This challenge will be announced at the event after the final round and is designed to test adaptability, social dancing skills, and how dancers respond in the moment.

      const beats = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".bbf-jj-beat"));
      const cards = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".bbf-jj-story-card"));

      if (!hype || slides.length < 2) return;

      const beatMap = [0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3];
      let index = 0;

      function setActive(nextIndex) {
        slides[index]?.classList.remove("is-active");
        beats[beatMap[index]]?.classList.remove("is-active");
        cards[beatMap[index]]?.classList.remove("is-active");

        index = nextIndex;

        slides[index]?.classList.add("is-active");
        beats[beatMap[index]]?.classList.add("is-active");
        cards[beatMap[index]]?.classList.add("is-active");

        hype.classList.remove("is-impact");
        void hype.offsetWidth;
        hype.classList.add("is-impact");
      }

      function next() {
        const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;
        setActive(nextIndex);

        const isGroupPhoto = nextIndex === slides.length - 1;
        window.setTimeout(next, isGroupPhoto ? 3600 : 1450);
      }

      window.setTimeout(next, 1450);
    })();
